sentences.en: After the project failed, he decided to do some introspection.
sentences.zh: 项目失败后，他决定进行一些内省。

sentences.en: Introspection can help you understand your own motivations better.
sentences.zh: 内省可以帮助你更好地理解自己的动机。

sentences.en: She regularly practices introspection to maintain self-awareness.
sentences.zh: 她经常进行内省以保持自我意识。
